info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Hazel Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Hazel Recliner Detail Management API is designed to streamline the creation and management of detailed information related to the Hazel Recliner product in the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to compile and upload essential details, including specifications, features, and pricing, ensuring that the product information is accurate and up-to-date. It is particularly useful for product managers and e-commerce platforms looking to enhance their furniture listings. Through this API, developers can efficiently manage product details while maintaining a consistent inventory experience for end-users.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create and submit details for the Hazel Recliner. Ensure that all required fields are filled out to successfully register the information.

requestBody.description: Request body to create or update details for the Hazel recliner. This includes specifications and attributes that define the recliner's features and options available to customers.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning detailed information about the hazel recliner.

CreateCatalogHazelReclinerDetailRequest.title: Hazel Recliner Request Body

hazel_recliner_id.description: The unique identifier for the Hazel recliner.

requestedBy.description: The name of the individual making the request.

quantity.description: The number of Hazel recliners requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request should be treated as a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Hazel recliner.

CreateCatalogHazelReclinerDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for operations related to the Hazel recliner. It includes details of the recliner ID, requester, quantity, priority status, and unit price.
